detaljer: Exact whole BACK VIEW impact phase 1816. Human Lee-Harvey faces directly away in very dark navy jacket/trousers, broad gray-blue shoulder panel/cuffs, brown hair back and tiny pink ears, narrow straight legs and dark boots. He holds Max horizontally behind/across head: both ears hang down-left in pink left grip, tiny black-eyed cream face just left of hair, hidden middle body and cream feet upright at far right in right pink grip. No raised rabbit fist above human head in this impact phase. Preserve EXACTLY TWO irregular PALE YELLOW stars: the larger high star is above-left of hair, the smaller second star farther right and slightly lower. Their long thin broken yellow trails descend toward the hair at their exact angles. Preserve all other tiny yellow rays/dots and the short WHITE zigzag strokes immediately above-left of hair. Follow this source 1816 placement and spacing, not another impact frame. Stars are pale yellow, not orange or deep gold, white marks remain white; no new orbit ring, extra stars, water or smoke. No added tail, body parts, Sam fragments, floor or facial details. One whole unified cel with faithful smooth outline and flat source colors.
